index.title: Ecosystem
index.lead: A collection of practical tools and extensions built around Grok Bot.

items.name: Grok Bot Clipper
items.desc: Package web selections, screenshots, and social content to deliver straight to your Bot.

clipper.slogan: Deliver great browser content straight to your Bot
clipper.lead: Supports web clipping, screenshots, social sharing, and material basket packaging. Connect your own account with no local connector required.
clipper.unofficial: A third-party extension independently developed by 铁柱AGI, not an official product of xAI or Cursor.
clipper.videoLead: Two quick walk-through videos covering everyday features.
clipper.featuresTitle: What You Can Do With It

features.v: Clip selections, article text, images, or tables, **fully preserving source links and context**.
Supports area selection, visible viewport, and scrolling screenshots, with **free cropping, annotation, and redaction before sending**.
**Directly select a Bot to receive content** from X, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and WeChat Official Accounts, retaining body text, author, metrics, and attachments.
Collect multiple web pages, screenshots, and local files, **bundling them into a single task to send to your Bot**.
Edit instructions and attachments before sending, **previewing and verifying the exact materials your Bot will receive**.
No need to leave the current page; **view Markdown responses directly in the sidebar and continue asking questions**.

extras.v: Supports Pinyin and initial search, allowing you to favorite frequently used bots and set a default Bot.
⌘⇧/Ctrl+Shift+7 area screenshot, 8 save web page, 9 quick command
Built-in display for 55 languages and regions, matching your browser by default.
Automatically generates numbered sources and Markdown body text, converting long articles into indexes and attachments.

steps.v: Go to the Feishu document and download the installation package for your browser.
Follow the documentation guide to load the extension in your browser's extension management page.
Pin it to the toolbar, open it, and authorize your own Grok Bot account.
Select the target Bot, send the clipped materials, and view the reply in the sidebar.

faq.a: No. **This is a third-party extension independently developed by me**, not an official product of xAI or Cursor.

faq.q: Does it require a local connector or self-hosted relay?
faq.a: No. **Simply authorize your account directly in the browser**—no self-hosted relay service needed.

faq.q: Where is data stored? Is there any telemetry?
faq.a: **The extension has zero analytics telemetry**. Data and records are stored in your current browser and only sent to your chosen Bot service.
**Supports Chrome and Edge 120+**, as well as Firefox desktop 140+.

faq.q: Can videos from all social platforms be captured?
faq.a: Not guaranteed. **We cannot guarantee every video can be fetched successfully**; if unavailable, it will be clearly labeled.

faq.q: Is the extension open source? Where is the source code?
faq.a: **The code is open-sourced on GitHub**. Proprietary code uses the MIT License, while third-party code and art assets retain their respective rights.

clipper.endTitle: Deliver Web Materials to Your Bot
clipper.endText: Go to the Feishu document to download the package and try it out in your browser right away.
